body.purpose: Thai and Latin interface copy across service and owner workflows.

shadows.purpose: Quiet separation for menu and queue cards.
shadows.name: shadow-sm

components.name: Checkout Action
components.description: The cashier's prominent action for advancing the current order.
components.css: .ds-checkout { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-accent-amber) 0%, var(--color-accent-hover) 100%); color: #fff; padding: 14px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); font: 600 1.05rem var(--font-family); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.35); transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-checkout:hover { box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.45); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-checkout:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary-700); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-checkout:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Touch-friendly menu item surface with a clear selection affordance.
components.css: .ds-product-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 10px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-cream-200); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--color-surface-white); color: var(--color-primary-900); text-align: left; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-product-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); border-color: var(--color-accent-amber); } .ds-product-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent-amber); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-product-card:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-product-visual { display: grid; place-items: center; height: 120px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-cream-100), var(--color-cream-200)); color: var(--color-primary-600); } .ds-product-name { font: 600 1rem var(--font-family); } .ds-product-price { font: 700 1.15rem var(--font-family-numeric); }

components.name: Active Navigation Tab
components.description: Selected workspace or workflow tab in the shared espresso navigation.
components.css: .ds-nav-tab { padding: 8px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-full); background: var(--color-accent-amber); color: #fff; font: 600 0.9rem var(--font-family); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-tab:hover { background: var(--color-accent-hover); } .ds-nav-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-tab:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Filter Pill
components.description: Compact queue filter with a high-contrast active state.
components.css: .ds-filter-pill { padding: 8px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--color-cream-300); border-radius: var(--radius-full); background: var(--color-surface-white); color: var(--color-text-muted); font: 500 0.9rem var(--font-family); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-filter-pill:hover { border-color: var(--color-accent-amber); } .ds-filter-pill[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--color-primary-800); background: var(--color-primary-800); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; } .ds-filter-pill:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent-amber); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-filter-pill:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Customization Option
components.description: A clearly selected size or preparation option in the order customizer.
components.css: .ds-option { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-cream-300); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--color-cream-100); color: var(--color-text-main); font: 500 0.95rem var(--font-family); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-option:hover { border-color: var(--color-accent-amber); } .ds-option[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--color-accent-amber); background: var(--color-accent-soft); color: var(--color-accent-hover); font-weight: 600; } .ds-option:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent-amber); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-option:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Barista Queue Card
components.description: Order queue surface; the top edge communicates its current preparation state.
components.css: .ds-queue-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 20px 20px 16px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-cream-300); border-top: 5px solid var(--status-pending-text); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--color-surface-white); color: var(--color-text-main); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-queue-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); } .ds-queue-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent-amber); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-queue-card.ds-pending { border-top-color: var(--status-pending-text); } .ds-queue-card.ds-cooking { border-top-color: var(--status-cooking-text); } .ds-queue-card.ds-ready { border-top-color: var(--status-ready-text); }

components.name: Foreground Dialog
components.description: High-priority foreground surface for customization and receipt flows.
components.html:
Customize drink

Choose size and sweetness.
components.css: .ds-dialog { width: min(100%, 540px); max-height: 90vh; overflow: auto; padding: 20px 24px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-cream-300); border-radius: var(--radius-xl); background: var(--color-surface-white); color: var(--color-text-main); box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl); } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--color-primary-900); font: 700 1.25rem/1.2 var(--font-family); } .ds-dialog:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent-amber); outline-offset: 3px; }

rules.body: Toasted caramel identifies the current action or selection; do not build a screen from competing saturated accents.
rules.name: The One Accent Rule

rules.body: Reserve the strongest lift for dialogs; working cards use ambient separation only.
rules.name: The Modal Foreground Rule

keyCharacteristics: Warm oat neutrals and deep, brown-tinted ink.
Prompt provides one consistent Thai and Latin type voice; tabular numerals keep prices aligned.
Refined 6–18px surface corners, with pills reserved for compact controls.
Solid, restrained accents; soft ambient shadows and a higher modal layer.
dos: Do use the shared semantic tokens across cashier, barista, and owner surfaces.
Do let spacing, weight, and clear state labels carry the hierarchy.
Do use tabular numerals for values that should scan or align quickly.
Do keep touch targets at least 44px where staff act during service.
Do reserve status colors for their operational meaning.
narrative.overview: The interface brings the considered warmth of a contemporary cafe to everyday service software. Deep-roast ink and oat-tinted surfaces form a calm foundation; a restrained toasted-caramel accent marks selection and the next useful action. The feeling is premium and composed, while controls remain familiar and quick to operate.`n`nThe cashier and barista work areas are designed for tablet and large touch displays. Product choices, order totals, queue states, and primary actions stay easy to scan. The owner dashboard uses the same system in a denser desktop layout. Information hierarchy comes from spacing, weight, and surface contrast instead of decorative gradients or generic black-and-white contrast.
donts: Do not use pure black, Inter, or saturated orange/purple gradients.
Do not let a gradient carry an action state; use a solid token instead.
Do not use cool gray as the default border or canvas color.
Do not make every surface a pill or oversized rounded card.
Do not rely on color alone to communicate order status.
